panels.title: Genuine pass rate (14d) — target > 95%
panels.description: Spec §8.1. Target: green when >= 0.95 sustained. Decision 5: 4 critical KPI auto-gated.

targets.query: from(bucket: "test-runs") |> range(start: -14d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_run" and r._field == "status" and r.branch == "${branch}") |> mean()

panels.title: Flaky rate (14d) — target < 3%
panels.description: Spec §8.2. Auto-gated. Computed from flaky_verdict.should_quarantine ratio.

targets.query: from(bucket: "test-runs") |> range(start: -14d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "flaky_verdict" and r._field == "should_quarantine") |> mean()

panels.title: False-positive rate (14d) — target < 1%
panels.description: Spec §8.2. Auto-gated. Tracked qua manual classification 'false_positive' tag emit từ classifier.

targets.query: from(bucket: "test-runs") |> range(start: -14d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_run" and r._field == "category") |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: if r._value == "false_positive" then 1.0 else 0.0 })) |> mean()
from(bucket: "test-runs") |> range(start: -14d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pipeline_duration" and r._field == "duration_seconds" and r.workflow == "ci.yml") |> quantile(q: 0.95)

panels.title: Critical flow coverage (latest) — target 100%
panels.description: Spec §8.1. Manual review (Decision 5). 4 critical flow: login, products, cart, checkout.

targets.query: from(bucket: "test-runs") |> range(start: -14d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "coverage" and r._field == "critical_flow_pct") |> last()

panels.title: MTTD (14d) — target < 30 min
panels.description: Spec §8.3. Manual review (Decision 5). Mean time test fail → GH Issue created.

targets.query: from(bucket: "test-runs") |> range(start: -14d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mttd" and r._field == "minutes") |> mean()

panels.title: MTTF P0 (14d) — target < 4h
panels.description: Spec §8.3. Manual review (Decision 5). Mean time P0 issue created → fix merged.

targets.query: from(bucket: "test-runs") |> range(start: -14d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mttf" and r._field == "hours" and r.severity == "P0") |> mean()
from(bucket: "test-runs") |> range(start: -14d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pipeline_duration" and r._field == "duration_seconds" and r.workflow == "regression.yml") |> quantile(q: 0.95)

panels.title: Pass rate trend (14d daily) — green-day count for sustain gate
panels.description: Done criteria §2: ≥ 10/14 ngày green = pass M6.

targets.query: from(bucket: "test-runs") |> range(start: -14d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_run" and r._field == "status" and r.branch == "${branch}") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean) |> yield(name: "actual")

from(bucket: "test-runs") |> range(start: -14d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_run" and r._field == "status") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: 0.95, _field: "target" })) |> yield(name: "target")

from(bucket: "test-runs") |> range(start: -14d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "flaky_verdict" and r._field == "should_quarantine") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean) |> yield(name: "actual")

from(bucket: "test-runs") |> range(start: -14d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "flaky_verdict" and r._field == "should_quarantine") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean) |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: 0.03, _field: "target" })) |> yield(name: "target")

panels.title: Green days / 14 (sustain ratio)
panels.description: Decision 5 gate: pass khi >= 10/14. Computed: count of days where pass_rate >= 0.95 AND flaky_rate < 0.03.

targets.query:
import "experimental"
from(bucket: "test-runs") |> range(start: -14d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_run" and r._field == "status") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= 0.95) |> count()

panels.title: Daily KPI breakdown (14d)
panels.description: Per-day view: pass_rate, flaky_rate, runs_count. Use for closure batch evidence.

targets.query: from(bucket: "test-runs") |> range(start: -14d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "test_run" and r._field == "status") |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: mean) |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
